extension.description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, run and debug commands for the TR (.tr) programming and AI language.
untrusted.limited: In untrusted (restricted mode) workspaces highlighting, snippets and file reading work; running, checking and debugging .tr files is disabled (the interpreter is not started). Files stored in coded form cannot be translated to your writing language, so they are shown read-only in their raw (coded) form.
config.title: TR Studio
config.interpreterPath: Full path of the TR interpreter (`tr.exe`). Read only from user settings; a workspace's own settings file cannot change it. A relative path is resolved only against a trusted workspace folder. If empty: `bin/tr.exe` or `tr.exe` at the root of a trusted workspace folder, then `tr` on PATH. Parent folders are not searched; a window without a folder uses only this setting and PATH.
config.autoOpenWatchPanel: Opens the **Watch Panel** (variable table and table grid) next to the editor every time the program stops while debugging.
config.writingLanguage: The writing language in which `.tr` files stored in coded form (first line `//! tr kodlu 3 dil=<language>`) are shown in the editor. The file is opened and edited in this language and written back to disk in coded form when saved; files that are not coded open as they are. Turkish (`tr`) or English (`en`); your own names, comments and texts stay as written, only the words of the language are translated. A change takes effect when open files are reopened.
task.file: Full path of the .tr file to run. If empty, the file in the active editor is used.
debugger.label: TR Studio
debugger.args: Command-line arguments passed to the program (e.g. ["--step", "5"]); the same for F5 and Ctrl+F5
debugger.stopOnEntry: If true, the program stops at the first line
debugger.cwd: Working folder of the program (relative file paths are resolved against it)
debugger.snippet.label: TR: Debug
debugger.snippet.description: Starts the VS Code debugger on the open .tr file
